title: About
text:
What if the key to running faster and jumping higher was hidden in just a few months of explosive training?
Over six months, this project will explore how to organize plyometric workouts for athletes and use published research to guide a progressive training plan.

About Me

Name: Marley John
Email: marley.p.john@gmail.com
GitHub: marleypjohn-beep
Final project repository: Plyometric-project
New College of Florida: ncf.edu

Baseball has been part of my life for as long as I can remember. As I got older, I became interested in strength training because I saw how it could help me perform better on the field. That curiosity led me to explore different ways to improve my athletic performance, including plyometric training.
I have practiced plyometrics for several years, and I feel it has helped me become a better player. I chose this project because I want to share what I learn about the principles behind this style of training and the potential benefits it can offer athletes.

title: About
text:
Data Sources
This project will use published research and coaching resources to inform a six-month plyometric training plan for athletes. The Coach Athletics article discusses four studies relevant to track-and-field coaches, and this research article on PubMed Central provides additional scientific background on plyometric training. These are background sources for the project, rather than a workout dataset.
